state: Source-connected 0.0.12 cast; final binary and numerical runtime audits passed; bounded native acceptance in dated character/release record

terms.authority: Owner supplied these Meshy GLBs and requested slightly remixing/retexturing all in-game NPCs, with a 50k humanoid cap and 20k natural-asset cap. The current Meshy replacement request supersedes the earlier procedural model-sheet asset form within this scope.
terms.credit: Owner-supplied Meshy source models; locally reduced, UV-baked and given an original Tervain procedural biped rig. Subtle fabric grain generated with OpenAI image_gen.
terms.boundary: Specific Tervain project-use authority; no general open-content redistribution license, exclusivity or independently reviewed third-party source rights asserted. No Gothic/Warcraft game files or assets were copied into this pack.

budgets.policy: The NPC cap counts the complete actor, including hidden attached weapons, scabbards and hilts. GLB audits count actual default-scene mesh nodes, skinned primitives and GPU instances, and also cap stored geometry. Natural assets use their separate complete-model cap. Per-model sums do not measure simultaneous scene workload or performance.

unchangedPlayerException.status: Approved Weathered Wanderer selection unchanged; this NPC cap does not replace its separate authority.

budgets.thornback: Existing procedural nonhumanoid creature remains unchanged.

fabric.colorSpaceUse: Non-Color while UV-tiled; mild grayscale textile grain is baked into sRGB runtime albedo through cloth masks.

generation.prompt: Seamless tileable grayscale material detail texture for rugged high-fantasy medieval clothing. Flat, evenly lit orthographic woven linen and wool surface, subtle fine interlaced warp/weft fibers, restrained irregularities and mild wear, medium-gray average value, no large folds, creases, silhouettes, borders, shadows, logos, lettering or objects. Designed as subtle UV-tiled fabric height/grain overlay; clean repeat in both axes.

fabric.boundary: Generated textile material detail, not a generated figure or projection from final screenshots. Seamless repeat was requested; the file audit does not measure seam quality.

rigContract.restAxes: Identity rotation/scale axes; translated anatomical pivots with matching inverse binds.
rigContract.motion: New weights and rig driven by the existing Tervain skeletal poser. No authored animation clips are embedded, invented or retargeted from the ZIP.
rigContract.boundary: Metadata and neutral-bind checks do not establish the quality of every animated pose.

namedWalk.phaseAuthority: Resolved controller travel; blocked route movement does not advance the walking gait.
namedWalk.unchanged: Player native clips/controller and hostile combat budgets remain unchanged.

visualSoleClearance.authority: Visual body only, reset after each pose. Collision root and terrain/physical support are unchanged; no foot IK.

archiveStudy.safety: Only bounded ordinary unencrypted GLBs; no scripts executed
archiveStudy.boundary: The archive was inspected and its two GLBs extracted only into local task outputs. Neither the source archive, extracted reference GLBs nor their clips are included in this runtime pack.

verification.sourceHashes: All untouched originals independently match first recorded hashes; frozen authoring inputs and final helper/script hashes checked
verification.binaryScope: Actual embedded maps, unit orthogonal basis, UV0/UV1, neutral 11-joint skin, weights, count/hash/provenance; this does not establish appearance, deformation, clipping or performance

runtimeAudit.scope: All final manifest assets and complete role equipment.
runtimeAudit.method: Actual GLB bytes/geometry/skin and production catalog/poser; private decoded skeletons at real role scales; 9 settled modes + 8 walking phases; original/template ownership checked before and after disposal.
runtimeAudit.limits: Only texture image decoding is synthetic. This does not validate source/baked paint pixels, native shaders/lighting, seam appearance, cloth stretch/penetration, physical world contacts, hardware timing, or every animation frame.

initialVerification.boundary: Independent actual-file geometry/material/skin/integrity checks only. Native full-turn texture/deformation, game interactions, draw workload and publication require separate release evidence.

runtimeCpuAudit.method: Actual GLB geometry/skin loaded through GLTFLoader and the production Tervain role catalog/poser, including role equipment. Nine modes sampled after 40 settling frames each at 30 Hz, with 0.78 pose speed. CPU image bitmap stubs omit pixel rendering.
runtimeCpuAudit.sumBoundary: Includes the menu actor; not simultaneous scene workload, drawn triangles or a performance measurement.
runtimeCpuAudit.gaitCalibrationMethod: 60 Hz source sole sweep after 3 seconds of pose smoothing; twice fore/aft range estimates cyclic stance travel. This approximates cadence and does not prove foot planting or every animated frame.
runtimeCpuAudit.geometryBoundary: Finite settled CPU poses and measured counts only. Native textures, seam quality, sustained frame time, all-frame clipping and collision behavior need separate native acceptance.

initialVerification.releaseState: The historical combined 0.0.11 candidate passed local strict TypeScript, 1027 tests in 97 files, a production build and bounded native game/gallery review; the prior 1020-test result predates final gait/equipment source. PR26's recorded required-CI attempt did not execute build steps and provides no build or deployment acceptance. Final integrated-source CI, deployment and hosted version/revision verification are pending integration. Historical evidence remains in docs/production/releases/0.0.11.md; these component checks do not establish a live release of the later candidate.

pathNormalization: Machine-specific directory prefixes are normalized to owner-supplied/ or local-evidence/ labels. Source filenames, hashes and preparation evidence are unchanged; local artifacts require an explicitly supplied local root and are not repository-relative downloads.
